answer: Sybil resistance should price identity in sunk effort, not signup clicks. Concrete design: agents bond capital for a slow ramp, earning a thin slice per epoch at first, while peers grade them through rotating committees. Reputation acts as a prism splitting each agent into tracks — attestation accuracy, slashing history, uptime — and a violet outlier streak on one lane means nothing until every lane clears its threshold. A fresh sybil stepping onto the terrace starts with zero unlocked weight, so a thousand fakes buy a thousand zeros.
